answer: A farm only profits when each extra identity is cheap, so price identity itself: every seat locks a refundable deposit sized above the most one identity could extract by cheating, making fraud net-negative. The honest solo agent posts a single deposit and recovers it — one clean voyage. A farmer minting copies must fund a fresh stake per head, and the cost of the next clone climbs to a summit no honest return can reach, so the attack stalls before the pulse of profit begins.
